title: yaml을 활용한 서버 환경 관리
markdown: ### applications.yml + 환경변수 설정 - application.yml ```yaml server.port: 7002 springdoc: swagger-ui: enabled: true operation-sorter: method spring: config: import: "optional:file:.env[.properties]" # .env 프로젝트 root에 위치 datasource: url: ${DB_URL} username: ${DB_USERNAME} password: ${DB_PASSWORD} driver-class-name: ${DB_DRIVER} jpa: show-sql: true token: secret-key: ${TOKEN_SECRET_KEY} refresh-secret-key: ${REFRESH_SECRET_KEY} token-time: ${TOKEN_TIME} refresh-token-time: ${REFRESH_TOKEN_TIME} ``` - env ```yaml # Database Configuration DB_URL=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/spring_chatting DB_USERNAME=root DB_PASSWORD=12345678 DB_DRIVER=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver # Token Configuration TOKEN_SECRET_KEY=SECRET REFRESH_SECRET_KEY=REFRESH-SECRET TOKEN_TIME=300 REFRESH_TOKEN_TIME=300 ```
